channel.title: Demo Wire
channel.description: Invented headlines for the Seems demo. None of this is real news.

item.title: Central bank holds rates, signals one cut before year end
item.description: The bank kept its main rate unchanged and said one reduction is likely before December if inflation keeps easing.

item.title: You won't BELIEVE what this one chart says about your savings
item.description: A look at average household savings over ten years.

item.title: Chipmaker beats forecasts as data centre demand grows
item.description: Quarterly revenue rose 18 percent, ahead of analyst expectations, driven by sales to cloud providers.

item.title: Open source database project ships major security fix
item.description: Maintainers urged users to upgrade after patching a flaw that allowed remote code execution.

item.title: Telescope spots water vapour on a distant rocky planet
item.description: Researchers detected water vapour in the atmosphere of a rocky exoplanet 40 light years away.

item.title: Oil prices jump to a six month high
item.description: Crude fell for a third day, touching its lowest level since spring as supply worries faded.

item.title: Doctors HATE this weird trick for perfect sleep
item.description: Sponsored: a pillow company describes its new product.

item.title: City marathon draws record number of runners
item.description: More than 40,000 people finished the race in mild weather on Sunday.

item.title: New phone OS update adds on-device translation
item.description: The update brings offline translation for 20 languages and longer battery life on older models.

item.title: Trial finds new vaccine cuts infections by half
item.description: A study of 12,000 adults found the vaccine reduced infections by 52 percent compared with a placebo.
